newsitem.title: USA: COREStaff buys staffing, tech companies.
newsitem.headline: COREStaff buys staffing, tech companies.

text.p: COREStaff Inc said Wednesday it had acquired Transworld Services Group and Cambridge Information Services Inc for cash.
Other terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
"Both transactions will contribute positively to COREStaff's earnings," it said.
It also said the addition of Cambridge Information Services Inc to its information technology group, COMSYS Information Technology Services, would lead to pro forma 1996 revenues of $307 million.
Cambridge Information Services is an information technology services company located in New York City with projected revenues of $6.5 million for 1996.
Transworld Services Group of Winter Park, Fla is a general staffing services company with revenues of about $35 million for the year ended September 30, 1996.
Since January, COREStaff has acquired eight information technology companies, four general support companies, and one technical writing company.
It said it expected to continue to look for other acquisitions.
COREStaff Inc provides temporary and contract staffing.
